rule: restates = applying the fix for that previous finding would also resolve the current one — the exact question loop-gate dedupe asks Jev
note: Every case has a unique critic + file, so no case can pair with another's findings. `restates` is the index into `previous`, or null when the current finding is new. `kind` names why the case is in the set; hard-* cases share a file, a line or most of their words with a previous finding and are still new.
